prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-81544
prose.body:
Hi Corvane Labs team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just wanted to send a quick, friendly nudge regarding our recent catering services. We noticed that invoice INV-81544 for 8249.25 USDC is still outstanding.

To make things easy, you can send the payment directly to our standard wallet address: 0x5115ba4952b2d465b4e86b4b33c694929050c5e5. This is the same address we use for all routine transactions, so no need to worry about new details.

If you have already sent this, please disregard this message. If you need a copy of the invoice again, just let us know and we’ll resend it right away. We truly appreciate your business and look forward to serving you again soon!

Best regards,
Larchmont Catering
